study_scope: Cao's historical Zhili statistical scope, Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 7. Shuntian and Tianjin are within the historical jurisdiction. Membership of concession residents in the source estimates is unquantified. No separate population is added for Beijing, Tianjin or concessions.

Cao's historical Shandong statistical scope, Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 5. Jiaozhou and Weihaiwei were leased in 1898. Their membership in the source estimates is unquantified. No separate population is added for either lease.

Cao's historical Guangdong statistical scope, Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 12. The dated jurisdiction includes Qiongzhou. The estimates do not document separate controls for Hong Kong, Macao or Guangzhouwan. The opening adds none of their populations separately.

Xinjiang became a Qing province in 1884. Ni Table 1.1 footnote and p. 18 list the 1880 value retrospectively within Cao's statistical scope. Gansu and Qinghai have separate rows. Coverage changes and comparison with the 1911 footprint are unquantified.
